category_edits.rationale: Index positions from the start of each observed history using cumulative nonpadding counts, preserving padding at zero. This may improve transfer between training prefixes and inference histories for short sequences. Preserve maxlen, embedding shapes, final-real-position readout, causal convolutions, scoring, loss and optimizer. The generated predictor imports this model class, so inference uses the same position construction automatically.
